title: The cosine-at-1 partial sums converge to cosOne
statement: CReal.Converges CReal.cosSeriesPartial CReal.cosOne -- cosOne is genuinely the limit of its own defining series. Built generically over a bound (k,h), never the concrete k_final, exactly as declare_converges_of_cauchy's own minor closure does, avoiding the stack-overflow trap CReal.e's construction documents.
